description:
Shows effect of assumed future inflation on the benefit. Compare to sample case 2, where there is no future
inflation.

Description

Shows effect of no assumed future inflation on the benefit. Compare to sample case 1, where there is
assumed future inflation.

Shows entered earnings, non-covered pension offset in 2022, retirement at exact age 62. Compare to sample
case 25, where the non-covered pension entitlement date is after the Social Security benefit entitlement
date. Also compare to sample case 30, which computes the benefit as of January 2024, when the non-
covered pension offset is no longer effective.

Description

       born September 2, 1960

       earnings of $2000 in 1981-90, $4000 in 1991-2000, $6000 in 2001-10, $8000 in 2011-20

Shows entered earnings, non-applicability of non-covered pension offset, retirement at exact age 62.
Compare to sample case 4, where the non-covered pension entitlement date is at or before the Social
Security benefit entitlement date. (The benefit in this case would be reduced beginning in October
2022.) Also compare to sample case 30, which computes the benefit as of January 2024, when the non-
covered pension offset is no longer effective.

Description
       Male old-age benefit, September 2022
       born September 2, 1960
       retired at exact age 62
       earnings of $2000 in 1981-90, $4000 in 1991-2000, $6000 in 2001-10, $8000 in 2011-20
       monthly non-covered pension of $1500 starting October 2022

Shows the wage-indexed non-freeze method for a disability benefit. Note that the non-freeze computation
uses 2004, the year of the start of the waiting period, for the year of eligibility, and the worker's earnings in
2003 and 2004, which are excluded from the normal wage-indexed formula computation, are used to
compute the non-freeze AIME.

Description

       disability onset July 1, 1999
       waiting period starts in August, 2004
